//: Build-only config. Identical to tsconfig.json except that test files are
excluded from emit, so dist/ contains shipping code only.
Two things depended on this: `prod` runs from dist/, so compiled tests were
being shipped; and a bare `bun test` picked up both src/ and dist/ copies,
running every backend test twice and reporting doubled failures.
verify-types deliberately stays on tsconfig.json (the full project) so test
files are still type-checked — they just aren't emitted.
